title: The server refuses agent forwarding
fault: The injection disables agent forwarding on the server.
signature: an empty SSH_AUTH_SOCK on the target
prompts: What does SSH_AUTH_SOCK hold on the target?
Who decides whether forwarding happens: the client, the server, or both?
hints: The command carries -A, so the client asked. Ask the server what it decided.
Run echo "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" on the target, and compare an allowed server with this one.

reveal.wrong: The injection set AllowAgentForwarding to no, so the server never opens the agent channel.
reveal.fix: Allow agent forwarding in the server config, or reach the target through a jump host that forwards.
